test: All input datasets are on the approved source list with a licence or an explicit fair-use note; no scraped operator content in the system of record
pass_criterion: 100% of inputs listed in data/sources.csv with tier A or an approved B

test: Every player id in the injury feed resolves to exactly one roster on the reported date; every team id resolves to 32 known clubs
pass_criterion: 0 unresolved ids across a full week
missing_input: 32-team roster sweep (S-15); stable numeric athlete id (Q-22)

test: For each prediction, only information published at or before the decision timestamp may be used; the harness must be able to reproduce that state
pass_criterion: Replay of a past week yields byte-identical inputs
missing_input: Event-sourced ingestion with timestamps on every fact

test: Same inputs + same spec hash => same output; environment and data snapshot recorded
Leg void/push/cash rules applied identically to backtest and forward ledger; a voided leg must not silently shorten a parlay
pass_criterion: Ledger reconciles to settlement source for 100% of settled tickets

test: Our probabilities must be calibrated: reliability curve within tolerance across deciles
pass_criterion: Max absolute calibration error <= 2.0 pts on a validation set
missing_input: Settled outcomes joined to our predictions (needs G-01)

test: Every EV computation is net of the actual price taken, not a nominal -110
pass_criterion: 100% of tickets carry an executed price and a benchmark price

test: Count of settled, independent, forward-tracked bets
Count of settled bets for the promotion tier
pass_criterion: n >= 1000 with no gap in tracking

test: Refit on expanding window; performance on the held-out tail must not collapse
Spec hash recorded before the first tracked bet; no post-hoc rule edits inside a measurement window
Mean closing line value with a bootstrap interval over tickets; luck removed by construction
Declared input/signal overlap between entries; entries sharing more than 60% of signals are merged into one family for reward purposes
Worst historical drawdown in units at the declared stake; assumed market capacity per game
pass_criterion: DD <= 12u and assumed handle <= 5% of available liquidity
